Shell(node --check public/app.js && echo "app.js OK" echo "--- stale design refs (should be none) ---" grep -rn "Oswald\|JetBrains\|2a9d8f\|2A9D8F\|FF4136\|ff4136\|panel--charging\|result-tile--dc\|appbar" public/ 2>/dev/null || echo "none" echo "--- app.js getElementById vs index.html ids ---" comm -23 <(grep -o "getElementById('[^']*')" public/app.js | sed "s/getElementById('//;s/')//" | sort -u) <(grep -o 'id="[^"]*"' public/index.html | sed 's/id="//;s/"//' | sort -u) | sed 's/^/MISSING IN HTML: /' || true echo "(dynamic-only ids like download-pdf are expected above)")

Shell(bash -c ' echo "IDs referenced in app.js but NOT static in index.html (dynamic ones are fine):" comm -23 <(grep -o "getElementById(\x27[^\x27]*\x27)" public/app.js | sed "s/getElementById(\x27//;s/\x27)//" | sort -u) <(grep -o "id=\"[^\"]*\"" public/index.html | sed "s/id=\"//;s/\"//" | sort -u) ' echo "--- serve check ---" python3 -m http.server 4177 --directory public >/tmp/psc5.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/psc5.pid sleep 1 for f in / /styles.css /app.js; do echo "$f -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4177$f)"; done kill "$(cat /tmp/psc5.pid)" 2>/dev/null; echo "server stopped")
Shell(find public context -type f | head -50 && echo --- && wc -l public/*.html public/*.css public/*.js 2>/dev/null; wc -l public/**/* 2>/dev/null | tail -20)

Shell(node -e  const fs=require("fs"); const css=fs.readFileSync("public/styles.css","utf8"); let depth=0,bad=false; for(const ch of css){if(ch==="{")depth++;if(ch==="}"){depth--;if(depth<0)bad=true;}} console.log("css braces balanced:",depth===0&&!bad); console.log("spinner rules present:", css.includes("::-webkit-inner-spin-button") && css.includes("-moz-appearance: textfield")); console.log("center-align rule present:", /\.compare-table th:nth-child\(n \+ 6\)/.test(css)); )
